title: kgateway nightly attached-routes measurements, July–October 2026
description: 864 control-plane performance measurements extracted from the public GitHub Actions logs of the kgateway nightly load-test workflow (attached-routes suite), 25 July - 21 October 2026, across the main, v2.4.x and v2.3.x branches, two Kubernetes versions, two validation modes and 1,000- and 5,000-route scales. Version 1.1.0 adds a pre-registered controlled A/B experiment (experiments/ab-14519): 32 trials on 8 GitHub-hosted runners comparing kgateway PR #14519 with its parent commit at 5,000 routes. Result: CONFIRMED, teardown median 1.33 s to 0.18 s (B/A 0.14, 95% block-bootstrap CI 0.10-0.25, paired Wilcoxon p=0.0078); setup time unchanged. Accompanies the ICPE 2027 industrial paper 'From One-Off Benchmarks to Nightly Performance Gates: Control-Plane Regression Testing for a Kubernetes Gateway API Implementation'. See README.md and experiments/ab-14519/PLAN.md.
